text: 胜宏科技公告，公司及泰国胜宏与中国银行(泰国)股份有限公司及保荐机构国信证券签署《募集资金四方监管协议》。该协议涉及公司向特定对象发行A股股票募集资金，募集资金总额约19亿元，净额约18.76亿元，用于泰国高多层印制线路板项目。
text_en: Victory Giant Technology announced that the company and Thailand Victory Giant signed a "Four-Party Supervision Agreement on Raised Funds" with Bank of China (Thailand) Co., Ltd. and the sponsor institution Guosen Securities. The agreement involves the company's fundraising from issuing A-shares to specific targets, with a total raised amount of approximately 1.9 billion yuan and a net amount of approximately 1.876 billion yuan, to be used for the Thailand high-layer printed circuit board project.
